description: Electric Vehicle Charging Equipment Rebates is a dataset listed in State of Delaware open data portal (data.delaware.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Delaware. A list of rebates for electric vehicle charging equipment. The state provides such rebates for Level 2 electric vehicle charging equipment. Coverage: Delaware. The portal files it under the category Energy and Environment. Its tags are dnrec, charging, vehicle, transportation, renewable. The table has 9 columns. Attribution on the portal: Department of Natural Resources and Environmental Control, Division of Energy an. The portal shows 2026-03-03 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-delaware-gov-portal.
